reason: 687 UTUC patients had RASSF1A promoter methylation measured by MSP and linked to recurrence-free survival, a retrospective cohort with a clear prognostic marker-outcome link.
The study evaluates IPSS-R prognostic value against clinical response to hypomethylating therapy but never reports an assayed methylation level in these MDS patients.
DNA methylation was profiled genome-wide in blood from 12 PTSD cases versus 12 trauma-resilient controls, a human case-control comparison even though no significant CpGs survived correction.
FoxP3 TSDR demethylation was directly measured in PBMCs across four groups of children with and without cow's milk allergy, linking the mark to dietary tolerance-induction treatment.
γH2AX, a histone modification, was quantified by immunofluorescence in lymphocytes from MCI patients versus controls and fed into a diagnostic classifier.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) was mapped across three regions of 79 colorectal tumors and tied directly to relapse-free and overall survival.
OXTR DNA methylation was measured in neonates from the Generation R cohort and analysed against prenatal maternal stress exposure and autistic-trait outcomes.
HPV16 L2 promoter methylation was assayed longitudinally by pyrosequencing in exfoliated cervical cells from the prospective Carolina Women's Care cohort.
This is a retrospective EEG/seizure phenotyping series in idic(15) syndrome with no epigenetic assay of any kind.
Global DNA (hydroxy)methylation was measured by LC-MS/MS in blood from pregnant women in the MANOE cohort and related to dietary methyl-donor intake.
The only marker developed and validated here is a three-microRNA (miR-223/miR-1269a/nc886) risk score, i.e. non-coding RNA rather than DNA methylation or a chromatin mark.
A DNA methylation panel (BHLHE22/CDO1/CELF4) was measured by QMSP in cervical scrapings from a case-control series to screen for endometrial cancer.
LINE-1 global methylation was measured directly in tissue from a cohort of 160 ESCC patients and linked to UHRF1 expression and clinical prognosis, alongside separate cell-line mechanistic work.
MGMT promoter methylation status was assessed alongside TERT mutation in a cohort of adult diffuse gliomas and combined into a prognostic classification.
Blood DNA methylation at smoking- and lung-cancer-associated CpGs was measured by HM450K in a population-based case-cohort and scored for prediction of lung-cancer mortality.
This IL6 study performs genotyping, expression, and eQTL analysis; methylation of IL6 is only proposed as future work, not measured here.
Increased H3K4 trimethylation from the EZH1 hot-spot mutation is reported from functional validation experiments rather than from measurement in the patient thyroid adenoma tissue itself.
HOX gene transcript overexpression and BCL-2 inhibitor sensitivity are assessed by expression profiling; no methylation, histone, or chromatin assay is reported.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was tracked longitudinally over 10 years in elderly twins and linked via survival analysis to aging-related outcomes.
RASSF1A and other gene promoters were assayed for hypermethylation in sputum from the NELSON lung-cancer screening trial to test screening-interval performance.
Testis-specific promoter methylation was quantified by MethyLight in paired testicular DNA and cell-free seminal DNA across azoospermic phenotype groups for diagnostic potential.
Barasertib was tested only in SCLC cell lines and mouse xenografts, with no human participant or human-derived sample data.

SMARCE1's mechanistic role is dissected in breast-cancer cell lines and xenografts, and the human-cohort component only correlates SMARCE1/PTK2 mRNA expression with prognosis, not any methylation or chromatin measurement in patients.
Cell-type-specific CpG methylation changes (e.g., AHRR cg05575921) were directly measured in blood from smokers versus non-smokers and prenatally exposed children.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation measures from the HumanMethylation450 assay were derived in a prospective nested case-control study of urothelial carcinoma risk.
Methylation microarrays profiled over 450,000 CpGs in trisomic versus normal placental DNA to search for non-invasive prenatal diagnostic markers.
The PRAVO study of vorinostat measured PBMC gene-expression and apoptosis markers, not histone acetylation or any other epigenetic mark.
This is a dietary-purchasing disparities analysis using NHANES and Nielsen data with no epigenetic content.
The study measures soluble CTLA-4 and cytokine responses to lupus autoantigens; no epigenetic marker is assayed.
BRM promoter SNPs that create epigenetic-silencing-associated transcription factor sites are genotyped, but no actual methylation or chromatin state is measured.
This is a SNP genotyping case-control study of the CDKN2A/2B locus; CDKN2A promoter hypermethylation is mentioned only as prior literature, not measured.
RTEL1 and PCDHGB6 promoter methylation was measured by qMSP-PCR in circulating-free DNA from lung-cancer patients versus healthy controls for liquid-biopsy diagnosis.
FOLR1 promoter methylation and global LINE1 hypomethylation were measured by MethyLight in a retrospective series of ovarian cancers and linked to survival.
An eight-CpG methylation risk score was built by array/pyrosequencing in an Asian LUAD training cohort and validated against methylation data from the TCGA cohort for prognosis.
This RCT compares two occlusal splints for temporomandibular disorder with no epigenetic measurement.
Plasma-cell differentiation subsets in myeloma are defined by CD19/CD81 immunophenotyping; CD81 is said to be 'epigenetically regulated' but no methylation or chromatin assay is reported.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (450K) in visceral adipose tissue distinguished insulin-resistant from insulin-sensitive obese patients, identifying ZNF714 methylation tied to metabolic risk.
This is an AACE/ACE clinical practice guideline document, not a primary study.
CpG-by-CpG methylation across the MGMT promoter/first exon was directly measured in 42 glioma patients and correlated with IDH1 mutation and gene expression.
GSTP1 promoter methylation was measured by MS-PCR in urine-derived DNA from prostate-cancer versus BPH patients to test a diagnostic biomarker.
CXCL12 promoter methylation was quantified by qPCR in a prostatectomy cohort and a TCGA validation cohort and linked to biochemical-recurrence-free survival.
The epigenetic clock (DNA methylation age) was measured in blood, saliva, and buccal samples across four large cohorts and related to menopause timing and hormone therapy.
5-hydroxymethylcytosine, a methylation-cycle mark, was measured by immunostaining in proliferative nodules versus melanomas to aid differential diagnosis.
Methylation of a six-gene panel was measured in peripheral-blood leukocyte DNA from a 421-case/506-control study and tied to colorectal-cancer susceptibility.
Only 3 children with cerebellar ganglioglioma are reported without a comparison group, despite MGMT methylation being assessed, making this a case series.
This is a single-patient case report of an infant with medulloblastoma treated with valproate.
MGMT promoter methylation status (by PCR) and EGFR expression were combined in 169 glioblastoma patients and validated in an external dataset for survival prognosis.
Promoter methylation of six candidate genes was quantified by bisulfite NGS in plasma cfDNA from breast-cancer patients versus healthy controls for early detection.
DNA methylation status of the miR-34 and miR-124 loci (not the microRNAs themselves) was measured by MSP in 157 NSCLC patients and linked to survival.
γ-H2AX histone phosphorylation was measured in PBMCs from a 146-case/146-control bladder-cancer study and linked to recurrence/progression risk.
TERT promoter (THOR) hypermethylation was measured by MeDIP-seq/pyrosequencing in a retrospective prostatectomy cohort and predicted biochemical relapse.
Genome-scale HM450K methylation was measured in 109 oral tongue carcinomas plus TCGA samples specifically to search for a prognostic signature, even though none was found.
This is a TLR9 SNP genotyping association study in SLE with no epigenetic marker measured.
MMR gene (MSH6/MSH3) and MGMT promoter methylation were directly assessed in serrated-polyposis lesions and compared between familial and sporadic subgroups to define molecular entities.
CADM1/MAL promoter methylation was measured in cervical scrapes from a prospective cohort of 364 treated CIN2/3 women to monitor recurrence risk.
IgG N-glycosylation is a post-translational protein modification, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin state.
This is a mass-spectrometry proteomic survey of human retina; MeCP2 is identified only as a differentially abundant protein, not as a measured methylation mark.
Urine DNA was tested for a panel of eight mutation and methylation biomarkers in a prospective diagnostic-accuracy study of bladder cancer detection.

CDX2 down-regulation is 'closely linked to... CIMP-high' tumors but the abstract does not say whether CIMP methylation was measured in this study or taken from prior characterization of the same cohort.

miR-449a silencing by DNA methylation was shown via demethylation-reagent treatment and MSP, but it is unclear whether the MSP assay was run on the patient FFPE specimens or only on medulloblastoma cell lines.
CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP) was directly assessed alongside BRAF/KRAS/MSI in 908 surgically resected colorectal cancers and linked to survival outcomes.

DNA methylation at maternal-smoking-sensitive CpGs was measured genome-wide in 736 case/control neonates from the California Childhood Leukemia Study to test genetic confounding of the smoking-methylation association.
The 2q35 breast-cancer locus is characterized by enhancer CNV genotyping and ERα-binding/expression correlation; no methylation, histone, or chromatin-state measurement is reported in patients.
This is a 13-patient cytopathology case series describing NUT midline carcinoma features with no comparison group and no epigenetic marker.
EZH2 is assessed only by immunohistochemical protein expression in breast-cancer tissue, not by measuring the H3K27 methylation mark it catalyzes.
ACE gene DNA methylation (%5mC) was measured in blood across four visits in a longitudinal panel study and linked to personal PM2.5 exposure and blood pressure.
A randomized crossover trial of true versus sham air purifiers measured LINE-1/Alu and gene-specific blood methylation to test mediation of PM2.5 effects on cardiovascular biomarkers.
Methylated RASSF1A circulating tumor DNA was measured by OS-MSP in serial plasma from breast-cancer patients to monitor neoadjuvant chemotherapy response.
Tumor LINE-1 methylation level was measured in 1,317 colorectal cancers from two prospective cohorts and analysed against tumor location and cancer-specific mortality.
The Methylated Septin-9 blood test was measured in a prospective series of CRC patients versus healthy controls and compared against stool occult blood testing.
This before/after observational study measured whole-blood DNA methylation (450k) following a standardized meal intervention in 26 healthy men.
miR-151-5p expression, a microRNA, is the marker profiled and validated as a BRCAness biomarker; the chromatin remodeler SMARCA5 is only its downstream target, not itself measured epigenetically.
SLC6A4 promoter methylation was measured at birth and discharge in preterm and full-term infants and linked to socio-emotional stress-response outcomes.
Illumina 450K methylation arrays classified 10 CRINET tumors alongside ATRT molecular subgroups, directly measuring methylation in human tumor tissue for differential diagnosis and prognosis.
Genome-wide and pyrosequencing methylation analysis of RAB25 was performed in paired lymph-node-positive/negative OOSCC tumors, including TCGA validation, to support metastasis diagnosis.
MLF1IP is evaluated purely as an mRNA expression biomarker in luminal breast cancer with no methylation or chromatin assay.
γ-H2AX foci, a histone modification marking DNA damage, were measured before and after escalating exercise distances in trained athletes.

The NOA-04 randomized phase III trial's exploratory analyses directly assessed CIMP and MGMT promoter methylation status in anaplastic gliomas and tied them to progression-free survival by treatment arm.
This phase II vorinostat trial in soft-tissue sarcoma reports clinical response and toxicity outcomes only, without any histone acetylation or other epigenetic assay.
This is a histological prevalence study of prostatic stromal tumors misdiagnosed as hyperplasia, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Genome-wide cord-blood DNA methylation (450K) was measured in a pilot birth cohort and analysed against regional air-pollution exposure and maternal HIV status.
Epigenome-wide tumor DNA methylation profiling in two prostate-cancer cohorts identified CpG biomarkers that stratified metastatic-lethal from nonrecurrent disease.

An integrated multi-omic analysis, including DNA methylation from the TCGA lung adenocarcinoma cohort, characterized the molecular profile of the aggressive 10-gene-signature subgroup linked to poor stage I prognosis.
Circulating histones are measured in plasma as a perioperative injury/inflammation biomarker after cardiac surgery, which is a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
BRAF V600E colorectal cancer subtypes are defined from gene-expression clustering and phosphoprotein levels, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Histone deacetylase inhibition with trichostatin A was tested only in C57BL/6 mice with postinfluenza pneumococcal infection.
Repeated-measures blood LINE-1 and Alu methylation were tracked prospectively in 583 participants and analysed against subsequent cancer incidence and mortality.
Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing measured DNA methylation in mother-child pairs and a larger LINA cohort, linking prenatal maternal stress to child methylation changes and wheeze risk.
Shati/Nat8l CpG island methylation was measured in peripheral blood of human schizophrenia patients versus healthy controls, in parallel with a mouse model, as a candidate diagnostic biomarker.
CpG-oligonucleotide is used only as a mitogenic stimulant to enable karyotyping/FISH in CLL specimens; no methylation or chromatin mark is measured.
Promoter methylation of 11 genes was measured by MSP in tumor tissue from a case-cohort study of clear-cell renal cell cancer and tested against alcohol and folate intake.
This is a value-of-information/decision-analytic modeling study of predictive biomarker research priorities, not a primary epidemiological study.
H3K4me3 and HP1 levels were measured directly in blood from nickel smelting workers versus matched office workers and correlated with employment length.
An Illumina450K cord-blood methylation score was developed and tested in a large newborn cohort (MoBa) as a biomarker of sustained maternal smoking in pregnancy.
OXTR promoter methylation across 12 CpG sites was measured in adult women and shown to mediate the effect of adversity on depression-related schemas.
This study evaluates serum hormones and testicular biopsy histology in cryptorchidism; DNA methylation is mentioned only as background biology, not measured.
A randomized crossover-controlled human exposure study measured bronchial epithelial DNA methylation at CpG resolution after diesel exhaust and allergen challenge.
Alu, LINE-1 and SAT-α methylation were measured by bisulfite-pyrosequencing in blood from 51 MS patients versus 137 matched controls and linked to disability score.
MBD2 is assessed by western blot and immunohistochemistry as a protein expression marker in HCC tissue, not as a direct measurement of DNA methylation.

Genome-wide methylation differences between keloid and normal skin were profiled purely for pathway/mechanistic insight, without linking the marker to a modifiable exposure or a specific clinical screening/diagnosis/treatment decision.
